name: ui-test-agent
description: AI-powered, browser-driven QA specialist for VS Code Copilot Chat. One-click install of the UI Test agent, 8 prompt entry points, and auto-configured Chrome DevTools MCP server.

commands.title: UI Test Agent: Install / Update Prompt Files
UI Test Agent: Open Prompts Folder
UI Test Agent: Remove Installed Prompt Files
UI Test Agent: Show Welcome / Usage
UI Test Agent: Show Chrome DevTools MCP Status
UI Test Agent: Check Environment (Node.js + Chrome)

uiTestAgent.autoInstallPrompts.description: Automatically copy the UI Test agent and prompt files into your VS Code prompts folder on activation. Existing files with local edits are preserved.

uiTestAgent.enableChromeDevToolsMcp.description: Register the Chrome DevTools MCP server (chrome-devtools-mcp) so the agent can drive a real Chrome browser. Requires Node.js / npx on PATH.

uiTestAgent.chromeDevToolsMcpVersion.description: npm version tag of the chrome-devtools-mcp package to launch (e.g. 'latest' or '0.7.0').

uiTestAgent.chromeExecutablePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a Chrome / Chromium / Edge executable. When set, this is passed to chrome-devtools-mcp as `--executablePath` and overrides auto-detection. Leave empty to let chrome-devtools-mcp auto-detect Chrome (or auto-download a Chromium build on first use).

uiTestAgent.chromeChannel.markdownDescription: Chrome release channel passed to chrome-devtools-mcp as `--channel`. Ignored when `#uiTestAgent.chromeExecutablePath#` is set.
